meta.phase: 1 of 2 - CLAIM LEDGER. Read-only over OUR OWN documents. No PDF was opened for content; only page counts and metadata were read for the inventory.
meta.purpose: Inventory every checkable factual claim we assert about a prior paper, flag the structurally risky ones, record contradictions between our own files, and hand the verification phase a per-paper worklist.
meta.rule: A claim needs (a) an exact PDF path, (b) which version, (c) the quoted sentence or table cell. Missing any of the three -> UNVERIFIED.
